exchanges: ok so we are officially calgary people now which is wild because two months ago i didnt even know where the good grocery stores were and honestly i still dont
Welcome! The grocery store thing sorts itself out fast once you have a routine.
diego started his new job last week hes a geologist for some oil and gas consulting firm so thats the whole reason we came out here and he loves it so at least one of us is settled lol
That's a big part of the move paying off already. How are you and the kids finding it so far?
kids are ok mateo is starting grade 3 next week and lucia is going into daycare part time which i have mixed feelings about but i need to find work too
Mixed feelings are completely normal there. A few days a week can be a gentle start for her.
the cat is NOT ok though churro has been under the bed since we got here and only comes out at night to eat and judge us
Cats often take a couple of weeks to adjust to a new place. Keeping his food and litter close to his hiding spot can help.
yeah we moved the litter box into the bedroom which is gross but whatever. oh and my sister ana called she just moved too, to winnipeg, for a hospital job so we're both new somewhere at the same time
That's kind of nice, you can compare notes on being the new person. Is she liking it?
she says its cold already lol which i mean yes obviously
Fair point, she was warned. At least you get the chinooks to break up the cold out here.
ok the school thing. we went to meet the teacher today and his teacher is ms fairweather she seemed really sweet and calm which is what mateo needs
A calm teacher is a great match for a kid in a new school. Did Mateo warm up to her?
kind of he hid behind me at first but then she showed him the class lizard and he was fine
A class pet is a pretty reliable icebreaker for an eight year old.
our neighbour came over with cookies his name is bashir and he has three kids so mateo has people to play with on the street
That's a lucky street to land on. Cookies and playmates in one visit is a good start.
hes an electrician and offered to look at the weird light in our hallway that flickers which i will absolutely take him up on
That's a generous offer, and flickering lights are worth having someone look at. Good neighbour to have.
ok so i was wrong earlier, fairweather is the principal not his teacher, his actual teacher is mr kowalczyk, the sweet lady we talked to was just doing the tours
Ah, that makes sense if she was showing families around. What's he like?
seems fine kind of quiet, he sent home a long email about reading logs
Reading logs are pretty standard for grade 3. They're usually just a few minutes a night.
lucia had her first pediatrician appointment here dr sandhu, mostly to transfer her file and get her puffer refilled
Good to get her file moved over early. Is the puffer something she uses daily?
no just when she gets a cold, she has asthma that flares up with viruses so daycare is going to be fun
Daycare colds are inevitable, but having a plan with the pediatrician helps a lot.
the doctor gave us a written action plan which honestly made me feel better
Those plans are really useful, especially for the daycare staff to have a copy.
yes ill give one to the daycare, lucias teacher there is ms abara, she has like 20 years experience
That much experience is reassuring for a first daycare.
diegos sister carolina also messaged, she and her husband moved to vancouver in the summer so now the whole family is scattered across the west lol
At least it's a short flight from you. Easier to visit than back home.
true we might go at christmas if we can afford it
That would be a nice first holiday out west.
anyway i applied to like four jobs today, mostly admin stuff
Four in a day is solid progress. Admin roles come up a lot in a city this size.
one is at the university which would be amazing because benefits
Benefits make a huge difference with two kids. Fingers crossed for that one.
mateo has a new friend from bashirs house, the middle kid, they built a fort out of our moving boxes
Best use of moving boxes there is. Sounds like he's settling in.
he is honestly better than me at this
Kids often are. You're juggling a lot more than he is.
so churro finally came out during the day today and sat on the windowsill for like an hour
That's a big step for him. Windows are great entertainment for cats.
but hes been sneezing a lot so i booked him at the vet down the road
Worth getting checked, new environments can stir up mild colds in cats.
vet is dr haddad, people in the neighbourhood facebook group love her so fingers crossed
Good reviews from neighbours are usually a reliable sign. Hopefully it's just a minor thing.
appointment is thursday morning, i have to figure out how to get him in the carrier
Leaving the carrier out with a blanket in it a day early can make it less scary.

questions.message: where did my sister end up moving to again
mateos teacher is ms fairweather right
what does carolina do for work
ok gonna try the blanket thing tonight wish me luck
